messages:
jenna_cs: Heads-up — HorizonPark flagged a sudden drop in API calls after their SSO rollout yesterday. Billing looks normal but their ML team stopped scheduled jobs. Can we do a quick sync? :eyes:
omar_csm: Thanks. Saw the alert. They also opened a support ticket saying integrations return 401s intermittently. Ticket #HP-824 is open. I pinged their eng contact but haven't heard back. :warning:
sam_solutions: I offered an extended demo and a temporary sandbox key while they sort SSO. They asked for a short walkthrough for their new ML lead. Could we prepare a one-pager and a short run-through?
maria_eng: I can join the walkthrough. Any error logs from them? I looked at traces and saw a couple of auth failures around 02:30 UTC. Might be token exchange issue with their IdP.
jenna_cs: Copy of the customer's note in the ticket: "After SSO migration, models stopped returning responses; we get 401 and sometimes 502. Evaluating alternatives this week." They mentioned a competitor pilot in parallel.
omar_csm: Competitor note is worrying. They said procurement wants evidence we can resume within 48h. Can we offer a 2-week dedicated capacity trial or a frictionless rollback path?
maria_eng: For the auth failures we need:

```
REQUEST 401 Unauthorized for acct horizonpark at 2025-04-11T02:30:12Z
headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer REDACTED' }
trace: kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback
```
If they can share a sample request+response we can repro. Also can enable an alternate auth endpoint for a short period.
sam_solutions: I'll ask them for the sample request and suggest enabling the alternate auth endpoint. I already drafted a 15-min demo focused on retry/backoff and token refresh. Want me to drop the draft here?
jenna_cs: Please do. Also adding a small commercial cover: 2 weeks free dedicated pool + priority eng onboarding. We shouldn't give away long-term discounts.
omar_csm: I'll coordinate with sales on the commercial note and flag procurement. @maria_eng can you confirm we can stand up the alternate auth endpoint in <8 hours if they approve?
maria_eng: Yes, we can spin up a temporary auth proxy and a sandbox key. ETA ~4-6h once we have customer approval.
jenna_cs: Great. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with customer for 14:00 their timezone and invite Maria and Sam. Omar, I'll loop sales and include the procurement ask.
deploy-bot: New ticket comment added by jenna_cs to HP-824 at 2025-04-11T09:12Z
jenna_cs: Next steps: 1) Sam requests sample request+response from HorizonPark (ASAP). 2) Maria preps proxy and shortwalk deck. 3) Omar coordinates commercial safety/2-week offer with sales. 4) Jenna runs customer invite and notes exec visibility. I'll update thread when meeting scheduled. :thumbsup:
